sentence: Within the field of light distribution schematically shown as a grid, the light pattern should be substantially uniform, i.e. the light intensity in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value being shown on the grid lines surrounding the questioned direction as a percentage. However, in the case of reversing lamps, if visual examination of a lamp appears to reveal substantial local variations of intensity, a check shall be made to ensure that no intensity measured between two of the directions of measurement referred to above is below 50 per cent of the lower minimum intensity of the two prescribed for these directions of measurement.

sentence: The conformity requirements shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and a geometric standpoint, in accordance with the requirements of this Regulation, if any, if the differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations.
text: The conformity requirements shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and a geometric standpoint, in accordance with the requirements of this Regulation, if any, if the differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations.

sentence: With respect to photometric performance, the conformity of mass-produced lamps shall not be contested if, when testing the photometric performances set forth in paragraph 4.8. of this Regulation of any lamp chosen at random: (a) No measured value deviates from the values prescribed in paragraph 6.1.3. of this Regulation. (b) If, in the case of a lamp equipped with a replaceable light source and if results of the test described above do not meet the requirements, tests on lamps shall be repeated using another standard light source.

sentence: The conformity of mass-produced lamps shall not be contested if the deviation of any specimen of samples A and B (all four lamps) is not more than 20 per cent. In the case, that the deviation of both lamps of sample A is not more than 0 per cent the measurement can be terminated.
text: The conformity of mass-produced lamps shall not be contested if the deviation of any specimen of samples A and B (all four lamps) is not more than 20 per cent, except that in the case that the deviation of both lamps of sample A is not more than 0 per cent the measurement can be terminated.
test_case: Measure four randomly selected production lamps (samples A and B) and confirm that no specimen deviates by more than 20 per cent.
quote: The conformity of mass-produced lamps shall not be contested if the deviation of any specimen of samples A and B (all four lamps) is not more than 20 per cent. In the case, that the deviation of both lamps of sample A is not more than 0 per cent the measurement can be terminated.

sentence: The following approval marking arrangements are given merely as examples and any other arrangement made in accordance with paragraph 3.3. of this Regulation is acceptable.

quote: The following approval marking arrangements are given merely as examples and any other arrangement made in accordance with paragraph 3.3. of this Regulation is acceptable.

sentence: For lamps (functions) using incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after photometric stability shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
text: For lamps (functions) using incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after photometric stability shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
condition: A lamp function uses incandescent technology only (the specification states LED modules).
test_case: Operate the lamp function until photometric stability and measure luminous intensities at all test points; all values within the minimum and maximum limits.
quote: For lamps (functions) using incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after photometric stability shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.

sentence: For reversing lamps and manoeuvring lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation, shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
text: For lamps (functions) using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, for reversing lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation, shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
test_case: Measure the reversing lamp luminous intensity distribution after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation; all test points within the minimum and maximum limits.
quote: For reversing lamps and manoeuvring lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation, shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.

sentence: The luminous intensity distribution after 1 and after 10 minutes of operation may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution measured after photometric stability has occurred by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at HV: (a) After 1 minute; (b) After 10 minutes; and (c) After photometric stability has occurred.
text: For lamps (functions) using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, for reversing lamps, the luminous intensity distribution after 1 and after 10 minutes of operation may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution measured after photometric stability has occurred by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at HV: (a) After 1 minute; (b) After 10 minutes; and (c) After photometric stability has occurred.
test_case: Where calculation is used, verify HV intensities were measured at 1 min, 10 min and at stability and the ratios applied at each test point; calculated values within limits.
quote: The luminous intensity distribution after 1 and after 10 minutes of operation may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution measured after photometric stability has occurred by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at HV: (a) After 1 minute; (b) After 10 minutes; and (c) After photometric stability has occurred.

sentence: For all other lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either - after 30 minutes of operation, or - after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
text: For lamps (functions) using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, for all other lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either - after 30 minutes of operation, or - after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
test_case: Measure the rear position and stop lamp intensity distributions after 1 min and after 30 min (or at photometric stability); all test points within the minimum and maximum limits.
quote: For all other lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either - after 30 minutes of operation, or - after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.

sentence: The luminous intensity distribution after 1 min of operation may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution either after 30 min of operation or after photometric stabilization, by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at HV after 1 min and either after 30 min of operation or after photometric stabilization.
text: For lamps (functions) using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, for all other lamps, the luminous intensity distribution after 1 min of operation may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution either after 30 min of operation or after photometric stabilization, by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at HV after 1 min and either after 30 min of operation or after photometric stabilization.
test_case: Where calculation is used, check the HV ratio (1 min vs 30 min or stability) was applied at each test point; calculated values within limits.
quote: The luminous intensity distribution after 1 min of operation may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution either after 30 min of operation or after photometric stabilization, by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at HV after 1 min and either after 30 min of operation or after photometric stabilization.

test_case: Review the photometric test report for checks at the Table A8-1 points in time (or ratio-based calculation from the reference coordinate); values within limits.

sentence: In case a lamp (function) uses LED technology only, a lamp (function) is deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time, if the values measured according to paragraph 1.2. are compliant.
text: In case a lamp (function) uses LED technology only, a lamp (function) is deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time, if the values measured according to paragraph 1.2. are compliant.

quote: In case a lamp (function) uses LED technology only, a lamp (function) is deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time, if the values measured according to paragraph 1.2. are compliant.
merged: In case a lamp (function) uses incandescent technology only, a lamp (function) is deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time, if the values measured according to paragraph 1.1. are compliant.

sentence: In case a lamp (function) uses any other light generating technology, the corresponding intensity requirements of a lamp (function) are tested and checked for compliance at the corresponding point in time listed in Table A8-1 and ending when photometric stability is reached.
text: In case a lamp (function) uses any other light generating technology, the corresponding intensity requirements of a lamp (function) shall be tested and checked for compliance at the corresponding point in time listed in Table A8-1 and ending when photometric stability is reached.
condition: A lamp function uses a light generating technology other than incandescent or LED.
test_case: Measure intensities from the Table A8-1 point in time until photometric stability; all values within limits.
quote: In case a lamp (function) uses any other light generating technology, the corresponding intensity requirements of a lamp (function) are tested and checked for compliance at the corresponding point in time listed in Table A8-1 and ending when photometric stability is reached.

sentence: In case a lamp (function) uses more than one light generating technology, the corresponding intensity requirements of a lamp (function) are tested following the strictest time requirements according to paragraphs 2.1.1. to 2.1.3. for the combination of them and checked for compliance.
text: In case a lamp (function) uses more than one light generating technology, the corresponding intensity requirements of a lamp (function) shall be tested following the strictest time requirements according to paragraphs 2.1.1. to 2.1.3. for the combination of them and checked for compliance.
condition: A lamp function uses more than one light generating technology.
test_case: Test intensities following the strictest time requirements of paragraphs 2.1.1 to 2.1.3; all values within limits.
quote: In case a lamp (function) uses more than one light generating technology, the corresponding intensity requirements of a lamp (function) are tested following the strictest time requirements according to paragraphs 2.1.1. to 2.1.3. for the combination of them and checked for compliance.

sentence: In case of doubt (e.g. unexpected run-up behaviour), the corresponding minimum intensity requirements of a lamp (function) are tested and checked for compliance at all points in time starting at the corresponding point in time listed in Table A8-1 and ending when photometric stability is reached.
text: In case of doubt (e.g. unexpected run-up behaviour), the corresponding minimum intensity requirements of a lamp (function) shall be tested and checked for compliance at all points in time starting at the corresponding point in time listed in Table A8-1 and ending when photometric stability is reached.
test_case: If run-up behaviour is doubtful, record intensity continuously from the Table A8-1 time until photometric stability; minimum values met throughout.
quote: In case of doubt (e.g. unexpected run-up behaviour), the corresponding minimum intensity requirements of a lamp (function) are tested and checked for compliance at all points in time starting at the corresponding point in time listed in Table A8-1 and ending when photometric stability is reached.
